description: SOC-thermal Nernst + Arrhenius-R model for ZBFB stack. Extends F1a with temperature-dependent R and Nernst thermal factor.

unit.name: Generic 60-cell ZBFB stack, 1000 cm2 electrode area
unit.source: Lim, H. S., Lackner, A. M., Knechtli, R. C. (1977). J. Electrochem. Soc. 124, 1154; Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011), J. Electrochem. Soc. 158, R55

E_a.note: Activation energy for ZBFB membrane/electrolyte resistance; Zn-Br complexing agent affects kinetics
E_a.source: Lim et al. (1977); Skyllas-Kazacos et al. (2011); Islam et al. (2017), J. Power Sources 349, 139

dOCV_dT.note: Temperature coefficient of standard potential for Zn/Br2; dE0/dT = -dS_rxn/(n*F). For Zn(s)+Br2(l)->ZnBr2, delta_S is small negative (-30 J/mol/K), giving dE0/dT ~ -0.00016 V/K. Smaller than many Li-ion systems.
dOCV_dT.source: Atkins Physical Chemistry (2014) thermodynamic data; Lim et al. (1977) J. Electrochem. Soc. 124, 1154

temperature.note: 15 to 40 degC; ZBFB electrolyte stability range
